situation (example wording): "juvenile crime in Texas in 2024" (a count of offenses or incidents with a juvenile)
what the app does today: A juvenile was read as a victim under 18 and the question declined.
proposed behavior: With no victim word in the question ("juvenile crime", "juvenile offenders"), juvenile means an offender under 18. With a victim word ("juvenile robbery victims") P120 applies: victims under 18. Everywhere a count is of an offender under 18 the words are the short form "with an offender under 18" (never "in the incident").
why: Jeff 2026-11-15: "Juvenile crime refers to offender age, not victim"; short form "Those work".
